requirements.text: The direction of impact of the child headform test to the front structure shall be downward and rearward.
requirements.quote: The direction of impact of tests to the front structure shall be downward and rearward.

requirements.text: A minimum of nine tests shall be carried out with the adult headform impactor, over the adult bonnet top test area and the adult windscreen test area together.
requirements.quote: A minimum of nine tests shall be carried out with the adult headform impactor, over the adult areas prescribed by the adult bonnet top test area and the adult windscreen test area together

requirements.text: Three tests shall be carried out to the middle third of the adult test areas and three tests shall be carried out to the outer third of the adult test areas, at positions judged to be the most likely to cause injury.

requirements.text: Where possible, at least one of the nine adult headform tests shall be carried out on the windscreen test area.
requirements.quote: Where possible, at least one of these nine tests shall be carried out on the windscreen test area.

requirements.text: At the discretion of the technical service, one of the nine adult headform tests may be conducted in the cowl monitoring area.

requirements.text: For each adult headform test on the windscreen, an undamaged and untested windscreen shall be used.
requirements.quote: For each test on the windscreen an undamaged and untested windscreen shall be used.

requirements.text: Adult headform tests shall be carried out to different types of structure, where these vary throughout the area to be assessed, at positions judged to be the most likely to cause injury.
requirements.quote: Tests shall be to different types of structure, where these vary throughout the area to be assessed and at positions judged to be the most likely to cause injury.

requirements.text: At the discretion of the Technical Service, and taking into account any symmetry of the windscreen and relevant structures, the number of tests on the windscreen test area may be reduced.
requirements.quote: Taking into account any symmetry of the windscreen and relevant structures, the number of tests on the windscreen test area may be reduced at the discretion of the Technical Service.

requirements.text: The selected measuring points for the adult headform impactor shall be a minimum of 165 mm apart.
requirements.quote: The selected measuring points for the adult headform impactor shall be a minimum of 165 mm apart

requirements.text: The selected measuring points for the adult headform impactor shall be within the adult headform test areas defined in paragraphs 2.1. and 2.44. of this UN Regulation.
requirements.quote: and within the adult headform test areas defined in paragraphs 2.1. and 2.44. of this UN Regulation.

requirements.text: The minimum distances between adult headform measuring points shall be set with a flexible tape held tautly along the outer surface of the vehicle.
requirements.quote: These minimum distances are to be set with a flexible tape held tautly along the outer surface of the vehicle.

requirements.text: No adult headform measuring point shall be located so that the impactor will impact the test area with a glancing blow resulting in a more severe second impact outside the test area.
requirements.quote: No measuring point shall be located so that the impactor will impact the test area with a glancing blow resulting in a more severe second impact outside the test area.

requirements.text: For the adult headform testing, a longitudinal impact tolerance of ±10 mm shall apply.
requirements.quote: For the adult headform testing, a longitudinal and transversal impact tolerance of ±10 mm shall apply.

requirements.text: For the adult headform testing, a transversal impact tolerance of ±10 mm shall apply.
requirements.quote: For the adult headform testing, a longitudinal and transversal impact tolerance of ±10 mm shall apply.

requirements.text: The adult headform impact tolerance shall be measured along the surface of the bonnet or the windscreen.
requirements.quote: This tolerance is measured along the surface of the bonnet or the windscreen.

requirements.text: The direction of impact of the adult headform test shall be in the longitudinal vertical plane of the vehicle to be tested at an angle of 65° ± 2° to the horizontal.
requirements.quote: The direction of impact shall be in the longitudinal vertical plane of the vehicle to be tested at an angle of 65° ± 2° to the horizontal.

requirements.text: The direction of impact of the adult headform test to the front structure shall be downward and rearward.
requirements.quote: The direction of impact of tests to the front structure shall be downward and rearward.

requirements.text: The maximum number of repetitions on a measuring point shall be 3 (i.e. 4 tests total) in this case.
requirements.quote: The maximum number of repetitions on a measuring point is 3 (i.e. 4 tests total) in this case.

requirements.text: Tests with atypical windscreen fracture shall be duly recorded in the test report.
requirements.quote: Tests with atypical windscreen fracture shall be duly recorded in the test report.

requirements.text: When the flexible lower legform impactor is used for a test according to paragraph 1.3.3. below, the absolute value of the maximum bending moment of the Tibia-3 shall be 139 Nm ≤ 166 Nm.

requirements.text: When the flexible lower legform impactor is used for a test according to paragraph 1.3.3. below, the absolute value of the maximum bending moment of the Tibia-4 shall be 90 Nm ≤ 111 Nm.

requirements.text: When the flexible lower legform impactor is used for a test according to paragraph 1.3.3. below, the absolute value of the maximum elongation of the ACL shall be 8.0 mm ≤ 10.5 mm.

requirements.text: When the flexible lower legform impactor is used for a test according to paragraph 1.3.3. below, the absolute value of the maximum elongation of the PCL shall be 3.5 mm ≤ 5.0 mm.
requirements.quote: (c) PCL shall be 3.5 mm ≤ 5.0 mm.

requirements.quote: For all these values for the maximum bending moment and the maximum elongation, the readings used shall be from the initial impact timing to 200 ms after the impact timing.

requirements.text: The instrumentation response value CFC, as defined in ISO 6487:2002, shall be 180 for all transducers.
requirements.quote: The instrumentation response value CFC, as defined in ISO 6487:2002, shall be 180 for all transducers.

requirements.text: The foam flesh for the test impactor shall be stored for a period of at least four hours in a controlled storage area with a stabilized humidity of 35 ± 10 per cent and a stabilized temperature of 20 °C ± 2 °C prior to impactor removal for certification.
requirements.quote: The foam flesh for the test impactor shall be stored for a period of at least four hours in a controlled storage area with a stabilized humidity of 35 ± 10 per cent and a stabilized temperature of 20 °C ± 2 °C prior to impactor removal for certification.

requirements.text: The temperature tolerances for the test impactor shall apply at a relative humidity of 40 ± 30 per cent after a soak period of at least four hours prior to their application in a test.
requirements.quote: The temperature tolerances for the test impactor shall apply at a relative humidity of 40 ± 30 per cent after a soak period of at least four hours prior to their application in a test.

requirements.text: The impactor mass shall be adjusted to give a mass of 12 kg ± 0.1 kg.

requirements.text: The impactor mass shall include those propulsion and guidance components which are effectively part of the impactor during impact.
requirements.quote: this mass includes those propulsion and guidance components which are effectively part of the impactor during impact.

requirements.text: Each protruding part of the external surface of the front bumper shall have a radius of curvature not less than 2.5 mm, except that parts of the external surface which protrude less than 5 mm are not subject to this requirement.
requirements.quote: No protruding part of the external surface shall have a radius of curvature less than 2.5 mm.

requirements.text: The outward facing angles of parts of the external surface of the front bumper which protrude less than 5 mm shall be blunted, save where such parts protrude less than 1.5 mm.
requirements.quote: This requirement shall not apply to parts of the external surface which protrude less than 5 mm, but the outward facing angles of such parts shall be blunted, save where such parts protrude less than 1.5 mm.

requirements.text: For gaps of between 40 mm and 25 mm between fixed or movable elements of the front bumper grilles and gaps, the radii of curvature shall be 1 mm or more.
requirements.quote: For gaps of between 40 mm and 25 mm the radii of curvature shall be 1 mm or more.

requirements.text: If the distance between two consecutive elements of the front bumper grilles and gaps is equal to or less than 25 mm, the radii of curvature of external faces of the elements shall not be less than 0.5 mm.
requirements.quote: However, if the distance between two consecutive elements is equal to or less than 25 mm, the radii of curvature of external faces of the elements shall not be less than 0.5 mm.

requirements.text: The distance between two consecutive elements of the front bumper grilles and gaps shall be determined according to the method described in paragraph 4. of Annex 3 to this Regulation.
requirements.quote: The distance between two consecutive elements of grilles and gaps shall be determined according to the method described in paragraph 4. of Annex 3 to this Regulation.

requirements.text: The junction of the front with the side faces of each element forming a front bumper grille or gap shall be blunted.
requirements.quote: The junction of the front with the side faces of each element forming a grille or gap shall be blunted.

requirements.text: The ends of the front bumper shall be turned in towards the external surface in order to minimize the risk of fouling.
requirements.quote: The ends of the bumpers shall be turned in towards the external surface in order to minimize the risk of fouling.

requirements.text: Where the front bumper is recessed or integrated within the bodywork, the requirement that the ends of the front bumper be turned in towards the external surface shall be considered satisfied.
requirements.quote: This requirement is considered to be satisfied if either the bumper is recessed or integrated within the bodywork or the end of the bumper is turned in so that it is not contactable by a 100 mm sphere and the gap between the bumper end and the surrounding bodywork does not exceed 20 mm.

requirements.text: Where the end of the front bumper is turned in so that it is not contactable by a 100 mm sphere, the gap between the bumper end and the surrounding bodywork shall not exceed 20 mm.
requirements.quote: This requirement is considered to be satisfied if either the bumper is recessed or integrated within the bodywork or the end of the bumper is turned in so that it is not contactable by a 100 mm sphere and the gap between the bumper end and the surrounding bodywork does not exceed 20 mm.

requirements.text: If the line of the front bumper which corresponds to the outline contour of the car vertical projection is on a rigid surface, that surface shall have a minimum radius of curvature of 5 mm at all its points lying from the contour line to 20 mm inward.
requirements.quote: If the line of the bumper which corresponds to the outline contour of the car vertical projection is on a rigid surface, that surface shall have a minimum radius of curvature of 5 mm at all its points lying from the contour line to 20 mm inward, and a minimum radius of curvature of 2.5 mm in all other cases.

requirements.text: If the line of the front bumper which corresponds to the outline contour of the car vertical projection is on a rigid surface, that surface shall have a minimum radius of curvature of 2.5 mm in all other cases.
requirements.quote: If the line of the bumper which corresponds to the outline contour of the car vertical projection is on a rigid surface, that surface shall have a minimum radius of curvature of 5 mm at all its points lying from the contour line to 20 mm inward, and a minimum radius of curvature of 2.5 mm in all other cases.

requirements.text: The outward facing angles of parts on or of the front bumper or bumper insets which have a projection of less than 5 mm, with special reference to joint covers and jets for headlamp washers, shall be blunted, save where such parts protrude less than 1.5 mm.
requirements.quote: The requirement of paragraph 6.5.2. above shall not apply to parts on or of the bumper or to bumper insets which have a projection of less than 5 mm, with special reference to joint covers and jets for headlamp washers; but the outward facing angles of such parts shall be blunted, save where such parts protrude less than 1.5 mm.

requirements.text: The bumper cover shall remain subject to the provisions of paragraph 5. of this Regulation.
requirements.quote: The provisions of paragraph 5. of this Regulation remain applicable.

requirements.text: The projection of door or luggage compartment handles shall not exceed 40 mm.
requirements.quote: The projection shall not exceed 40 mm in the case of door or luggage compartment handles and 30 mm in all other cases.

requirements.text: The projection of all other handles, hinges and push-buttons of doors, luggage compartments and bonnets, and of fuel tank filler caps and covers, shall not exceed 30 mm.
requirements.quote: The projection shall not exceed 40 mm in the case of door or luggage compartment handles and 30 mm in all other cases.

requirements.text: Where folds in body panels of the front bumper have a radius of curvature of less than 2.5 mm, the radius of curvature shall be not less than one-tenth of the height H of the projection, measured in accordance with the method described in paragraph 1. of Annex 3 to this Regulation.
requirements.quote: Folds in body panels may have a radius of curvature of less than 2.5 mm provided that it is not less than one-tenth of the height "H" of the projection, measured in accordance with the method described in paragraph 1. of Annex 3 to this Regulation.

requirements.text: Where the supporting brackets provided by the vehicle manufacturer for registration plates are contactable by a 100 mm diameter sphere when a registration plate is fitted in accordance with the vehicle manufacturer's recommendation, the supporting brackets shall comply with the requirements of paragraph 5.4. of this Regulation.
requirements.quote: Supporting brackets provided by the vehicle manufacturer for registration plates shall comply with the requirements of paragraph 5.4. of this Regulation if they are contactable by a 100 mm diameter sphere when a registration plate is fitted in accordance with the vehicle manufacturer's recommendation.

requirements.text: When determining the corner of bumper, the external devices for indirect vision and the tyres shall not be considered.
requirements.quote: The external devices for indirect vision and the tyres shall not be considered.

requirements.text: Where the lower bumper height of the vehicle is less than 425 mm, the requirements of paragraph 4.1.1. shall be applied.
requirements.quote: For vehicles with a lower bumper height of less than 425 mm the requirements of paragraph 4.1.1. shall be applied.

requirements.text: Where the lower bumper height of the vehicle is greater than or equal to 425 mm and less than 500 mm, the requirements of either paragraph 4.1.1. or 4.1.2., at the choice of the manufacturer, shall be applied.
requirements.quote: For vehicles with a lower bumper height which is greater than, or equal to 425 mm and less than 500 mm the requirements of either paragraph 4.1.1. or 4.1.2., at the choice of the manufacturer, shall be applied.

requirements.text: Where the lower bumper height of the vehicle is greater than or equal to 500 mm, the requirements of paragraph 4.1.2. shall be applied.
requirements.quote: For vehicles with a lower bumper height of greater than, or equal to, 500 mm the requirements of paragraph 4.1.2. shall be applied.

requirements.text: To verify compliance with the performance requirements in paragraph 5.1.1., the test impactor specified in paragraph 6.3.1.1. shall be used.
requirements.quote: both the test impactor specified in paragraph 6.3.1.1. and the test procedures specified in paragraph 7.1.1. shall be used.

requirements.quote: both the test impactor specified in paragraph 6.3.1.2. and the test procedures specified in paragraph 7.1.2. shall be used.

requirements.text: When tested in accordance with paragraph 7.1.1. (flexible lower legform to bumper), the absolute value of the maximum dynamic medial collateral ligament elongation at the knee shall not exceed 22 mm.
requirements.quote: the absolute value of the maximum dynamic medial collateral ligament elongation at the knee shall not exceed 22 mm

requirements.quote: the maximum dynamic anterior cruciate ligament and posterior cruciate ligament elongation shall not exceed 13 mm.

requirements.quote: The absolute value of dynamic bending moments at the tibia shall not exceed 340 Nm.

requirements.text: When tested in accordance with paragraph 7.1.2. (upper legform to bumper), the bending moment on the test impactor shall not exceed 510 Nm.

requirements.quote: When tested as a DPPS, the test conditions and requirements in Annex 1 shall apply.

regulations.rationale: R42 governs the low-speed collision behaviour of the front protective device of M1 vehicles, which this front bumper is. (lexical: term match score 2.4)
Pedestrian safety for M1 vehicles requires the front bumper lower leg impact zone to meet legform and energy-absorption performance, so this product must fulfil it. (lexical: term match score 9.6)
External projections of M1 vehicles cover bodywork such as the bumper cover, so the bumper must limit injury risk from contact with its surface. (lexical: term match score 5.7)

Pedestrian safety GTR covers the lower legform and bumper impact zone of M1 vehicles, which this bumper's lower leg impact zone must meet in markets using GTR 9 rather than R127. (lexical: term match score 15.7)
